episode.title: A Fair Division
episode.scene: Evening in the attic bedroom, with warm golden lamplight pooling across weathered floorboards. Ichigo, a tiny silvery-white dwarf hamster with a neat charcoal stripe down her back, sits triumphantly buried up to her chin inside an enormous, tightly wound cocoon of soft knitted blanket scraps. Two feet away on the bare floor, Teddy, a massive shaggy apricot Syrian hamster, sits calmly on his haunches with his solid glossy black bead eyes fixed on her, gently holding a single fraying thread of wool between his two stubby paws.
episode.caption: She insisted they split it right down the middle.
episode.arcNote: Ichigo hogged the entire nest blanket under the guise of an equal compromise, leaving Teddy with a single thread.
episode.arcUpdate: Settled into their attic flat routines, with Ichigo claiming dramatic domestic victories and Teddy calmly letting her.
